declarations.name: AuiTreeSelect
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI TreeSelect: `<aui-tree-select>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label (accessible name).

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.description: The tree (see Tree View).

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Single choice or multiple choice with checkboxes and tags.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; one hidden input per selected id.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Placeholder while nothing is selected.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text below the field.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: At least one value is required.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Not interactive and not submitted by Form.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable, but the value cannot change.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Show errorMessage as an external error.

inputs.name: errorMessage
inputs.description: Message shown while invalid is true.

inputs.name: clearable
inputs.description: Show a button that clears the selection.

inputs.name: selectableParents
inputs.description: Single mode: parents can be chosen; otherwise choosing a parent opens it.

inputs.name: cascade
inputs.description: Multiple mode: checking a parent checks its descendants.

inputs.name: expanded
inputs.description: Ids expanded in the popup tree (paths to the value are expanded too).

inputs.name: loadChildren
inputs.type: ((node: TreeNode, context: TreeViewLoadContext) => Promise<readonly TreeNode[]>) | null
inputs.description: Lazy children (see Tree View).

inputs.name: valueLabels
inputs.description: Labels of selected ids whose nodes are not loaded yet.

inputs.name: popupHeight
inputs.description: Block size of the tree in the popup.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Popup placement and tree arrow keys.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Row height of the popup tree.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Expand, clear, remove, and error icons.

inputs.name: openOnFocus
inputs.description: Open the popup when the field receives focus.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages and filtering.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the value: { value, added, removed }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: The id (single) or ids (multiple) for Form.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear interaction state.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox with a tree popup (aria-haspopup=tree). The field keeps focus while typing; Down Arrow moves DOM focus into the popup tree, which follows the APG tree pattern (see Tree View); Escape returns focus to the field.

limitations: Filtering searches loaded nodes only; lazy children are searched after they are loaded.
A selected id whose node is not loaded shows its valueLabels entry, or the id itself.
Multiple mode with cascade stores every checked id (parents and children); tags show the topmost fully checked node.
